name: Lantern Sloth
summary: A sign-in page that starts dark: light the paper lantern and a sleepy sloth wakes to guard the form
about: A full sign-in page that opens in darkness with Sumo the sloth asleep on a branch beside a paper lantern. Tap the lantern and its warm light spreads across the page, moths come out and Sumo slowly wakes up to watch you type, covering his eyes with his claws when you reach the password. Good for a cosy app, a kids or animal brand, or any login that should make people smile.
how: The page starts dark with Sumo snoring on his branch; tap the lantern (or press Enter on it) to light it
The light spreads, moths circle the lantern, Sumo yawns awake and the sign-in card rises into the light
Type your email and Sumo's eyes and head follow the caret; on the password field he covers his eyes, and Show password lets him peek
Press Sign in: a vine grows across the button while he watches, then leaves and sparks burst on success or he shakes his head on an error
Use Fill demo for the working login, Sign out to start again, and tap the lantern again to let Sumo sleep
